records.issue_text: packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:58 — A failed cancellation aborts the loop and skips all queued Prisma deletions, leaving successfully cancelled reminders in the database. Retrying those reminders triggers SendGrid errors for already-cancelled batches and can indefinitely block subsequent cleanup. Handle failures and persist successful deletions per reminder.
records.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a real bug in the code. Looking at lines 52-73 in scheduleEmailReminders.ts, the loop uses `await client.request({...})` inside a for...of loop. If any single SendGrid API call fails (rejects), the error will propagate up and exit the loop immediately due to the await. This means: 1) Any reminders after the failed one won't be processed, 2) The `workflowRemindersToDelete` array already populated with successful Prisma delete promises won't be executed because `await Promise.all(workflowRemindersToDelete)` is never reached.
